fields.meta_title: Proposal Automation: Draft, Approve, Sign | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build proposal automation that drafts from the CRM deal, holds discounts above your limit for approval, reads RFPs, and records signatures.
fields.h1: Build Proposal Automation That Takes Deals to Signature
fields.hero_description: Build proposal automation that fills the first draft from a CRM deal and follows it through approval and signature.
fields.features_subheading: Each part takes one job off the person who writes the proposal.
fields.feature_1:
Drafts that start from the CRM deal

When a deal reaches the stage you choose, the app pulls the client, the contacts, and the scoped services from your CRM into the template. Reps open a priced draft, not a blank page.
fields.feature_2:
One library of approved sections

Case studies, team bios, and contract terms sit in a database you own, each with an owner. The app inserts only the version marked current, and a retired bio stays out of new drafts.
fields.feature_3:
Discount limits per role

Set the largest discount each role can give on its own. A proposal past that limit stays locked. The approver gets a direct message or an email showing the list price and the offer.
fields.feature_4:
RFPs read into a requirement list

An AI step reads each uploaded RFP and lists its requirements, deadlines, and page limits as fields. Any value it reads with low confidence goes to a person before writing starts.
fields.feature_5:
Signatures that update the deal

Clients sign inside the proposal app. The signed copy, the signer's name, and the time are saved to your database, and the deal in your CRM is marked won at the signed amount.
fields.feature_6:
Export the app's code to GitHub

Paid plans export the full code of the proposal app to your GitHub repository, pricing rules included. A pricing change can then be reviewed like any other commit in that repo.

fields.usecase_heading: Four Proposals the App Moves Forward
fields.tab_content_1:
Tallowbrook's deal turns into a priced draft

Ottoline Brask moves the Tallowbrook Cidery rebrand deal to the Proposal stage in HubSpot. The app reads the deal and builds Marrowgate Creative's proposal from it: discovery at $8,400, identity design at $16,200, and a $24,600 total. The draft then waits for Ottoline's review before it goes to the client.
fields.tab_content_2:
A 20% discount waits for the sales director

Deshawn Pellerin at Wexcombe Analytics wants to close Halverson Freight and offers 20% off the $48,000 annual list price. Any discount over 15% needs the sales director's approval. The $38,400 proposal is locked and goes to Aurelie Nakashima in a direct message. Deshawn cannot send it until she approves.
fields.tab_content_3:
38 requirements, one value for a person to check

Bellwyn Systems has 21 days to answer a 46-page RFP from the Ashbourne Valley Water District. The app reads it and lists 38 requirements, each with an owner. One value is read with low confidence: the technical volume's page limit. Joaquin Thorvaldsen, the proposal manager, confirms it first.
fields.tab_content_4:
One signature marks the HubSpot deal won

Solveig Imbert of Quarrystone Senior Living signs Kestrelmoor Landscape Architects' $31,500 courtyard redesign proposal. The app saves her signature with the signed copy and marks the deal won in HubSpot. Caius Brannigan, the project lead, gets a direct message with the signed proposal attached.

fields.howto_description: Seven steps to map your proposal process, build proposal automation with Emergent, and test it on past deals.
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Choose the stage that starts a draft
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Load only content you would send
fields.howto_step_1_des: Pull the last 10 proposals your team sent and mark what changed between them: client name, scope, prices, and case studies. Whatever stayed the same becomes the template. Whatever changed becomes a field the app fills from the deal.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Pick the CRM stage that should start a draft (Proposal, for example) and list the deal fields the template needs. Emergent builds the app from a prompt that names that stage and every field the draft should fill.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write the pricing rules down before you prompt: the list price for each package, the largest discount each role may give, and who approves anything above it. A rule you cannot state in one sentence needs a decision from sales leadership first.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Move case studies, team bios, and standard terms into the content library, with one owner for each item. Leave out anything you would not send to a client today. A smaller library means fewer wrong sections in a draft.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Connect the CRM and the signature
fields.howto_step_5_des: Connect your CRM through its API. The app then reads each deal and writes the result back to it. Add the signature step last, and choose who hears about a signed proposal: the account owner or the project lead.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Send five past deals through the app before going live. Compare each draft with the proposal you sent at the time, check that every discount over the limit stopped for approval, and fix any rule by prompting until all five match.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Go live with one team first
fields.howto_step_7_des: Switch the app on for one sales team or one proposal type for 30 days. Count the drafts that went out without edits, trace each edit back to the rule or field that caused it, and fix that rule before the next team moves over.

faq_plan.q: What is proposal automation in government contracting?
faq_plan.ref: what is proposal automation in government contracting
faq_plan.a: In government contracting, proposal automation is software that reads a solicitation and tracks the response against each requirement. Under the FAR, RFPs are used in negotiated acquisitions to communicate Government requirements to prospective contractors. Section L of the uniform contract format holds the instructions to offerors; Section M holds the evaluation factors.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up proposal automation?
faq_plan.a: Set it up around one proposal type, the one your team sends most. Describe its trigger stage, the deal fields it fills, and its discount limit in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder, which builds the app and connects it to your CRM. Send a few live deals through it beside your current process before you switch over.

Proposal automation is the use of technology to perform actions in the proposal process with reduced human intervention; it is sometimes called bid automation. Automate the repeatable parts first, such as filling the template from deal data and routing approvals. People still decide the scope and the price.

faq_plan.q: How is sales proposal automation different from a proposal template?
faq_plan.a: A template is a fixed document someone copies and edits by hand; sales proposal automation fills it from the deal, prices it by your rules, and follows it until the client signs. It is one part of sales automation, which also covers lead routing and follow-ups.

faq_plan.q: What do I need to automate sales proposals?
faq_plan.a: You need three things to automate sales proposals: a template with fields, written rules for pricing and approvals, and a connection to the CRM that holds each deal. Emergent turns those into one app from a prompt and keeps every proposal in a database you own.

faq_plan.q: How to shorten sales cycles with RFP and proposal automation?
faq_plan.ref: how to shorten sales cycles with rfp and proposal automation
faq_plan.a: Cut the days your own team adds. Treat the RFP due date as fixed and assign every requirement on the day the RFP arrives, with internal deadlines a week before submission. Start each answer from the one your team gave in its last bid. On sales proposals, start the draft at the deal stage instead of after a kickoff meeting.

faq_plan.q: How do proposal automation tools improve win rates?
faq_plan.ref: how proposal automation tools improve win rates
flagged: PA6 asker unclear: headline (how X does Y)
faq_plan.a: They raise win rates indirectly: writers get back the hours that went into assembly and spend them on the client's problem and your approach. Track your win rate per proposal type before and after rollout. Attach your W-9 and payment details to the proposal as well, ready for the buyer's accounts payable automation.

faq_plan.q: How much time does proposal automation save per proposal?
faq_plan.ref: how much time does proposal automation save per proposal
faq_plan.a: It saves the time your team spends on assembly: copying client details into the template and pasting sections from old proposals. Put a number on it by timing five proposals built by hand and five drafted by the app. An app built with Emergent can record both times on every proposal and show the gap on a dashboard.

faq_plan.q: How does proposal automation shorten the B2B sales cycle?
faq_plan.ref: how proposal automation shortens b2b sales cycle
flagged: PA6 asker unclear: headline (how X does Y)
faq_plan.a: It shortens a B2B sales cycle by removing the second document. Put the terms and the order form inside the proposal: one signature then accepts the price and closes the deal. Without that, a signed proposal can sit while a separate contract goes through the buyer's legal review.

faq_plan.q: How does proposal automation software speed up the sales cycle?
faq_plan.ref: how proposal automation software speeds up sales cycle
flagged: PA6 asker unclear: headline (how X does Y)
faq_plan.a: It speeds up the sales cycle by showing where the days go. Stamp each proposal when its draft is built, when the discount is approved, and when the client signs, then fix the slowest stage first. If the same deal also needs a contract or a statement of work, build that with document automation on the same deal data.
